## 1. Executive Summary, CAC Registration & Corporate Profile

**Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd** is an active, duly incorporated Nigerian corporate entity registered with the **Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) under Registration Number RC 1441429**, established to bring transparency, engineering rigor, and structural longevity to property and facility management.

Across Nigeria's rapidly urbanizing landscape, property investments are frequently compromised by uncoordinated estate administration, delayed preventative maintenance, and opaque financial accounting. Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd provides a dependable, institutional-standard alternative.

Headquartered at **No. 12, Liberty Drive, Off Alcon Road, Woji, Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria** ([View on Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=No.+12+Liberty+Drive+Off+Alcon+Road+Woji+Port+Harcourt+Rivers+State+Nigeria)), and providing nationwide operational management across **Port Harcourt, Lagos, Abuja**, and surrounding hubs, we manage a diverse portfolio comprising residential gated communities, commercial complexes, and industrial facilities.

Our multidisciplinary team unites certified estate surveyors, facility managers, registered mechanical/electrical (MEP) engineers, and seasoned tenant relations professionals. Every project is executed with strict adherence to industry regulations, Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards, and transparent financial reporting.

### 01. Estate Management

- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**

### 02. Property Management and Administration

- **URL:** https://www.eniolajunglobalservices.com/services#property-management

- **Full Description:** Our property management service lifts the operational burden off landlords. We oversee tenant vetting, lease documentation, prompt rent collection, dispute resolution, regular preventative inspections, and prompt renewals to ensure zero vacancy rates.
- **Scope & Key Deliverables:**
  - Rigorous tenant screening & background verification
  - Legal lease agreement preparation & renewals

  - Prompt tenant query resolution & tenancy record-keeping

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q: Is Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC)?**
A: Yes. Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd is an active, duly incorporated Nigerian corporate entity registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) under Registration Number RC 1441429.

**Q: How quickly can Eniolajun Global commence facility or estate management?**
A: Following an initial on-site physical inspection and agreement on the Scope of Work (SOW), our team can mobilize within 3 to 5 business days with security protocols, technical maintenance schedules, and financial administration structures.

**Q: Do you manage residential estates as well as commercial towers?**
A: Yes. We manage gated residential communities, luxury apartment complexes, multi-tenanted corporate plazas, commercial logistics centers, and retail parks across Nigeria.

**Q: How is service charge collection and accounting handled?**
A: We operate designated transparent client bank accounts with monthly reconciliation. Resident and landlord executives receive itemized balance sheets showing collections, vendor payments, diesel supplies, and contingency reserves.

**Q: Are your building maintenance artisans certified?**
A: All electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and generator technicians undergo rigorous technical competency assessments, background vetting, and work under registered supervisory engineers.
